description:
Based on **Morphe Patches 2.4.0**

### ✨ New features

* **YouTube - Ambient mode:** Show the light of Enhanced Ambient mode behind the comments panel of fullscreen
* **YouTube - Automotive layout on car displays:** Use the automotive layout on a car display
* **YouTube - Captions:** Add "Copy transcript" setting
* **YouTube - Change form factor:** Hide the navigation bar on a car display
* **YouTube - DeArrow:** Add "Clean up titles" setting
* **YouTube - Feed video actions:** Keep the thumbnail badges and buttons over the inline preview
* **YouTube - Fullscreen video scale:** Add "Fullscreen video alignment" setting
* **YouTube - Hide ads:** Hide YouTube Premium exclusive videos
* **YouTube - Hide layout components:** Add "Hide 'Visit the Community' section" setting for comments
* **YouTube - Hide layout components:** Add "Hide Badges", "Hide 'Liked videos'" and "Hide 'Watch later'" settings for the You tab
* **YouTube - Hide layout components:** Add "Hide Topics" setting
* **YouTube - Hide layout components:** Add `Duration filter`
* **YouTube - Hide layout components:** Add `View count filter`
* **YouTube - Hide layout components:** Split "Hide Chapters and 'In this video' button" into separate settings
* **YouTube - Hide Shorts components:** Hide standalone Shorts cards in modern home feed layout
* **YouTube - Hide status bar:** Add "Keep player below display cutout"
* **YouTube - Hold gesture:** Add a launcher that opens with a drag up
* **YouTube - Keyword filtering:** Add "Hide posts by keywords" setting
* **YouTube - Navigation bar:** Add "Account switcher shortcut" setting
* **YouTube - Navigation bar:** Add glass navigation bar edge and bottom margin settings
* **YouTube - Navigation bar:** Long press the Settings button to open the other settings
* **YouTube - Navigation bar:** Restore the toolbar Cast button hidden by YouTube, and add "Hide Cast button" and "Hide Companion button" toolbar settings
* **YouTube - Navigation bar:** Support "Account switcher shortcut" on versions before 21.30
* **YouTube - Playback in feeds:** Add "Show seek buttons in feeds" setting
* **YouTube - Search comments:** Rename patch to `Comment search`
* **YouTube - Spoof video streams:** Add "Web" client
* **YouTube - Spoof video streams:** Show "Signed in" in stats for nerds for every client that fetched the video signed in, such as TV and the web clients
* **YouTube - Wide search bar:** Show the search bar in You tab
* **YouTube / YouTube Music - Video effects:** Edit an effect by long pressing in the effect list dialog
* **YouTube / YouTube Music:** Add `Video effects` patch
* **YouTube:** Add `Android Auto parked app mode` patch
* **YouTube:** Add `Ghost mode` patch
* **YouTube:** Add `Glass menus` patch
* **YouTube:** Add `Hold gesture` patch
* **YouTube:** Add `Open post images in fullscreen` patch
* **YouTube:** Add `Playlist search` patch
* **YouTube:** Add `Return YouTube Username` patch
* **YouTube:** Add `Reverse playlist autoplay` patch and "Reverse order" setting for "Play all" patch
* **YouTube:** Add `Ungroup notifications` patch
* **YouTube:** Add replay slower button and swipe
* **YouTube Music:** Add `Apple Music animated artwork` patch
* **YouTube Music - Downloads:** Add 1080p, 1440p and 4K to the in-app download video quality
* **YouTube Music - Downloads:** Export albums and playlists to their own folders
* **YouTube Music - Downloads:** Include album artwork in exported music
* **YouTube Music - Hide buttons:** Add "Hide 'Ask Music' button" setting and Toolbar screen
* **YouTube Music - Navigation bar:** Add "Hide Samples button" setting for the toolbar
* **YouTube Music - Navigation bar:** Add "Show Settings button" setting to the navigation bar and toolbar
* **YouTube Music - Spoof video streams:** Add visionOS and Android VR experimental clients
* **YouTube Music - Third-party lyrics:** Add fullscreen lyrics mode
* **YouTube Music - Third-party lyrics:** Add offline Kuromoji romanizer, custom font upload, inline share editor, separate cache clearing, and romaji/CJK sweep fixes
* **YouTube Music - Third-party lyrics:** Add smooth word sweep, inactive blur, relaxed scroll, duet alignment, section pill redesign, and fix sync and toggle lag
* **YouTube Music:** Add `Android Auto third-party apps` patch
* **YouTube Music:** Add `Disable swipe to change track` patch
* **YouTube Music:** Add `Glass menus` patch
* **YouTube Music:** Add `Queue likes filter` patch
* **YouTube Music:** Add `Sonos Cast` patch
* **Disable DRC audio:** Disable the DRC version of the audio, and add "Disable loudness normalization" setting
* **GmsCore support:** Universal GNP / Chime push notification registration support
* List contributors for all time, 6 months, 3 months
* Redesign of the About dialog
* **Spoof video streams:** Add "Use QuackJS" setting
* **Spoof video streams:** Update yt-dlp-ejs

### 🔧 Other improvements

### 🌟 RLX extras

* **Voice-over translation (Yandex)**: plays a Yandex voice-over translation of the video, next to Morphe's own translation (YouTube)
* **Save to device**: built-in downloader for videos, audio, thumbnails and subtitles, with a library and an offline player with SponsorBlock (YouTube)
* **Quick download menu** for [YTindir](https://github.com/Ramik4/ytindir): qualities with codec and file size, audio (M4A, MP3) and the thumbnail (YouTube and YouTube Music)
* **RLX branding**: app icons, header logos, startup animation and app names, next to the original ones
* **RLX settings**: clearer sections, with *RLX Customizations* for the app name, icon, logo, font, theme colors, language and import / export
* **Recommended settings** from the first start, kept on updates and restorable with *Restore RLX default settings*
* **About page** with the RLX and Morphe versions, update check, release notes and credits

### 📱 Supported versions

* **YouTube** 21.30.216 (up to 21.47.483, experimental)
* **YouTube Music** 9.30.53 (up to 9.47.51, experimental)
